name: io.rugmunch/pry
title: Pry — Web Scraping, Browser Automation & Data Intelligence MCP
description: Self-hosted web intelligence MCP: scrape, crawl, extract, monitor, parse, screenshot, x402 pricing, plus ten data domains (crypto, marketplace, legal, real estate, jobs, travel, attention, local, gov, ip).

tools.name: pry_scrape
tools.description: Scrape any URL to clean, readable markdown, automatically bypassing Cloudflare, DataDome, Akamai, and other anti-bot systems via a 15-tier fallback chain (direct -> cloudscraper -> FlareSolverr -> Playwright -> Googlebot -> Archive.org -> Google Cache -> Tor -> undetected-chromedriver). Use when you need the text content of a page a plain HTTP request cannot fetch, e.g. a Cloudflare-protected article or a JS-heavy blog post.

tools.name: pry_crawl
tools.description: Crawl a website from a seed URL, discovering and scraping linked pages with BFS/DFS traversal up to max_pages. Use to collect an entire docs site, blog, or directory — e.g. call with url='https://example.com' and include_paths=['/docs/'] to harvest every page under /docs/, or crawl up to 50 blog posts with max_pages=50. Constrain with include_paths/exclude_paths to stay inside the section you want.

tools.name: pry_extract
tools.description: Extract structured data from a URL using CSS selectors — 10x cheaper than LLM extraction — and return JSON matching your schema. Use when you need specific fields like {title, price, image, availability} from product listings or search results pages.

tools.name: pry_template
tools.description: Execute one of 110+ pre-built scraper templates (amazon-product, walmart-product, linkedin-profile, etc.) that return site-specific structured data. Use when scraping a known site that already has a template instead of hand-writing CSS selectors — e.g. 'amazon-product' for an Amazon product page.

tools.name: pry_search_templates
tools.description: Search the 110+ pre-built scraper template catalog by keyword, category, or site name, returning matching template_ids, their categories, and descriptions. Use before pry_template to discover which template fits a target site — e.g. call with q='walmart' to find 'walmart-product', or q='jobs' with category='careers' to list every job-board template.

tools.name: pry_monitor
tools.description: Create a content-change monitor that notifies via webhook, Slack, or Discord when a page changes, using AI to judge whether changes are meaningful. Use to track competitor pricing or product availability over time, e.g. 'notify me when this price page changes'.

tools.name: pry_compliance
tools.description: Compliance intelligence in two modes: pass a URL to check whether scraping it is legally safe (robots.txt, ToS, GDPR/CCPA, PII exposure -> green/yellow/red risk score with recommendations), or pass query/agency to search regulatory compliance records — enforcement actions, fines, sanctions, and watchlist entries, e.g. query='Binance' for its regulatory history. Use before scraping an uncertain site or when screening a company for compliance exposure.

tools.name: pry_enrich
tools.description: Enrich a URL with company info, tech stack detection, social profiles, and competitive intelligence. Use to build a prospect profile from their website before outreach, e.g. discover what stack a startup runs and find their LinkedIn.

tools.name: pry_parse_document
tools.description: Parse a document (PDF, DOCX, image) and extract its text and tables using pdfplumber, Tesseract OCR, and python-docx. Use to pull content from a PDF spec, a scanned brochure, or a Word file, e.g. extract the pricing table from a vendor's PDF.

tools.name: pry_screenshot
tools.description: Render a URL in a headless browser and return a screenshot as a base64-encoded PNG with width, height, and content type. Use for visual verification or design QA of a rendered page — e.g. screenshot https://example.com/checkout with full_page=true to capture the whole checkout flow before launch. JavaScript is executed before capture so SPAs render correctly.

tools.name: pry_x402_pricing
tools.description: Get current x402 pay-per-call pricing for all Pry operations, showing the cost in USDC atomic units and supported networks for each tool. Use before a paid call to display the cost to the user, e.g. 'how much does a pry_scrape cost?'.

tools.name: pry_balance
tools.description: Read the prepaid balance of a Pry account (bulk scrape credits purchased via crypto). Pass your pry API key (e.g. api_key='pry_abc123_deadbeef...') or a user_id to see the USD balance + low-balance flag. Use before buying a pack to confirm you can afford an operation, or after a purchase to confirm the credit landed (e.g. after a 5000-credit starter pack you should see ~5.00 USD). This is a free read of your own account — it does not spend credits.

tools.name: pry_buy_pack
tools.description: Initiate a crypto purchase of a bulk scrape-credit pack. Pass a pack id (e.g. pack_id='starter' for $5/5,000 credits) and it returns a spec-compliant x402 PaymentRequired manifest with the real receiving wallet as payToAddress and the server-authoritative price in atomic units. The agent/partner pays USDC on-chain (or the quoted asset, defaults to the configured network), then calls the confirm endpoint with the tx hash to credit the balance — and on first purchase an API key is minted. An empty payToAddress in the response means the operator hasn't configured a receiving wallet; never pay a placeholder address.

tools.name: pry_referrals
tools.description: Get Pry's referral catalog — 60+ providers across LLM, hosting, email, monitoring, proxies, and devtools — each link carrying our affiliate ID for revenue attribution. Use to find a revenue-share partner or pick a recommended provider, e.g. 'what proxy providers do you refer?'.

tools.name: pry_kol_leaderboards
tools.description: Scrape KOL / crypto-influencer leaderboards for usernames (handles), wallets, followers and P&L / win-loss stats. Reads public trader leaderboards (kolscan.io Solana trader board; gmgn.ai and dexscreener smart-money boards are registered but Cloudflare/JS-gated and flagged [REVIEW]). Use to grow a KOL watchlist, e.g. 'pull the top KOL wallets from the kolscan leaderboard' or 'find new crypto influencer handles + wallets'.

tools.name: pry_token_launches
tools.description: Discover new crypto token launches, new liquidity pairs, and trending tokens across chains (Solana, Ethereum, Base, ...) with optional age filtering. Use to find early-stage tokens before they hit mainstream trackers, e.g. 'what new Solana tokens launched in the last hour?' or 'show me trending tokens on Base'.

tools.name: pry_cex_listings
tools.description: Get recent centralized-exchange (CEX) listing and delisting signals — e.g. Binance, Coinbase, Kraken — aggregated over a configurable lookback window. Use to time research on tokens that just landed on a major exchange, e.g. 'what did Coinbase list in the last 24 hours?'.

tools.name: pry_amazon_product
tools.description: Look up a single Amazon product by its ASIN (e.g. 'B08N5WRWNW') and return current price, title, availability, rating, and listing details from the marketplace intelligence provider. Use to check a product's live price or stock, e.g. 'what does B0BLVMHNF1 cost right now?'.

tools.name: pry_amazon_search
tools.description: Search Amazon products by keyword and return matching listings — title, price, rating, and ASIN for each result (up to limit). Use to compare prices or discover products, e.g. 'search Amazon for wireless mechanical keyboards'.

tools.name: pry_walmart_product
tools.description: Look up a single Walmart product by its product ID (e.g. '4JH7P89H7X5P') and return current price, title, availability, seller, and rating from the marketplace intelligence provider. Use to check a Walmart listing's live price or stock, e.g. 'what does Walmart product 4JH7P89H7X5P cost?'.

tools.name: pry_tiktok_trending
tools.description: Get currently trending products on TikTok Shop, ranked by engagement and sales velocity, with price, sales count, and shop info for each result (up to limit). Use to spot viral commerce opportunities, e.g. 'what's trending on TikTok Shop right now?'.

tools.name: pry_token_security
tools.description: Run a security scan on a crypto token by chain and contract/mint address — checking for honeypots, hidden mints, ownership concentration, LP lock, and other rug-pull risk signals. Use before investing in or reporting on an unfamiliar token, e.g. 'scan So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112 on solana'.

tools.name: pry_legal_dockets
tools.description: Search U.S. federal and state court dockets by full-text query using the free CourtListener REST API v4, returning docket titles, courts, and case numbers. Use to monitor litigation against a company, person, or trademark before it hits the news, e.g. 'what lawsuits involve OpenAI?' or 'show dockets mentioning this company name'. Results are best-effort: the free tier has no auth and degrades to an empty list on network or rate-limit failure.

tools.name: pry_legal_sec
tools.description: Search SEC EDGAR filings for a public company by ticker and form type, returning filing dates, form names, and EDGAR accession numbers. Use to track regulatory filings that move markets, e.g. 'recent 8-K filings for AAPL' or 'all 10-Q filings for TSLA this year'. Backed by the free EDGAR Full-Text Search and submissions feed; never raises and returns an empty list on failure.

tools.name: pry_legal_sanctions
tools.description: Screen a person or entity name against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) sanctions list, returning any matching records with their sanctions program and remarks. Use for compliance due diligence before onboarding a counterparty, partner, or wallet-linked entity, e.g. 'is Vladimir Potanin sanctioned?'. Backed by the free OFAC SDN XML downloads, cached in-process; returns an empty list when the name is clean or the feed is unreachable.

tools.name: pry_realestate_search
tools.description: Search real-estate listings by location and status (for_sale, for_rent, sold), returning address, price, beds/baths, square footage, and listing URLs. Use for market research, comps, or lead generation, e.g. 'what's for sale in Austin, TX under $500k?'. Scrapes Zillow search pages with a Redfin GIS API fallback (both free and keyless); never raises and returns an empty list when the source is unreachable.

tools.name: pry_jobs_list
tools.description: List current job postings for a company from its applicant-tracking system (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, or Workday), returning normalized titles, locations, remote flags, and application URLs. Use for talent-market intel or recruitment pipelines, e.g. 'what engineering roles is Stripe hiring for?'. Reads the free, public, keyless JSON boards; never raises and returns an empty list when the board is unreachable or the company slug is unknown.

tools.name: pry_jobs_salary
tools.description: Get per-level salary bands (total compensation, base, stock, bonus) for a company and role from Levels.fyi's public embedded data. Use to benchmark compensation offers or market rates, e.g. 'what does Google pay software engineers at L5?'. Scrapes the free Levels.fyi page with no auth; never raises and returns an empty object when the company or role is not found.

tools.name: pry_flights_grid
tools.description: Get the cheapest flight option per day between two dates for an origin and destination pair, using Google Flights' public tfs deep-link page. Use to find the cheapest day to fly on a trip, e.g. 'what's the cheapest day JFK→CDG next month?'. Returns a per-day price grid; never raises and returns an empty grid when Google Flights blocks the scrape (embedded JSON drifts over time).

tools.name: pry_hotel_rates
tools.description: Get per-night hotel rates for a stay window from Google Hotels with a Booking.com fallback, both free and keyless page scrapes. Use to compare prices across sources for a specific property, e.g. 'what does the Ritz Paris cost for September 10-14?'. Returns per-night rate breakdowns; never raises and returns an empty object when neither source is reachable.

tools.name: pry_serp
tools.description: Scrape a Google search results page for a query, returning organic results, the AI Overview text when present, and People Also Ask questions. Use for SEO rank tracking or competitor SERP analysis, e.g. 'who ranks for best wireless keyboard?'. Built on the free public Google results page; never raises and returns an error payload when Google serves a consent or CAPTCHA wall.

tools.name: pry_trends
tools.description: Measure Google Trends interest over time for a keyword, returning the daily interest timeline and related queries. Use to validate demand for a product, content topic, or token narrative before committing resources, e.g. 'is AI agents interest rising?'. Built on the free Trends public endpoint; never raises and returns an error payload when the endpoint is unreachable.

tools.name: pry_places_search
tools.description: Search Google Maps for local businesses matching a query and location, returning name, rating, review count, address, and place IDs for lead generation. Use to build prospect lists for outbound sales, e.g. 'find coffee shops in Austin TX'. Backed by the free Google Maps public search page; never raises and returns an empty list when the page is unreachable or blocked.

tools.name: pry_reviews
tools.description: Get the full review history for a local business place from Google Maps or Yelp, going beyond the 5-review API cap. Use to analyze customer sentiment, common complaints, or reputation before outreach, e.g. 'what do customers say about this restaurant?'. Accepts a Google place CID/slug or a Yelp biz slug; never raises and returns an empty list when the source is unreachable.

tools.name: pry_procurement
tools.description: Search U.S. federal procurement opportunities and contract awards from the public SAM.gov data feed, returning title, agency, notice type, and deadline. Use to find government business opportunities for a capability, e.g. 'what cybersecurity contracts are open?'. The gov_data module is built in parallel; until it lands this tool returns a readable not-available message instead of erroring.

tools.name: pry_recalls
tools.description: Search recent product recalls from the U.S. CPSC public data feed, returning product name, hazard, recall date, and remedy. Use for consumer-safety monitoring or supply-chain due diligence, e.g. 'recent recalls for e-bike batteries'. The gov_data module is built in parallel; until it lands this tool returns a readable not-available message instead of erroring.

tools.name: pry_patents
tools.description: Search U.S. patents by keyword using the USPTO public data feeds, returning patent number, title, assignee, and grant date. Use for IP landscaping or freedom-to-operate checks, e.g. 'patents for blockchain identity'. The ip_data module is built in parallel; until it lands this tool returns a readable not-available message instead of erroring.

tools.name: pry_trademarks
tools.description: Search U.S. trademarks by keyword or owner using the USPTO public data feeds, returning serial number, mark text, owner, and status. Use for brand clearance before launching a product or token name, e.g. 'is RugMunch trademarked?'. The ip_data module is built in parallel; until it lands this tool returns a readable not-available message instead of erroring.

tools.name: pry_odds
tools.description: Get live betting odds across major bookmakers (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, ESPN BET, ...) for one or more sports, backed by The Odds API (free tier via PRY_ODDS_API_KEY) with an ESPN scoreboard fallback. Each record includes the event label, market, bookmaker, and decimal odds for home/away. Use to compare lines before placing a bet or to power an odds aggregator, e.g. 'what are the current NBA moneyline odds across books?' or call with sport='nfl' to see the full NFL slate.

tools.name: pry_arbitrage
tools.description: Scan sportsbook lines for guaranteed-profit arbitrage opportunities: the same event quoted at different books where the combined implied probabilities total under 100%. Use to find risk-free bets, e.g. 'show me NFL arbitrage opportunities with at least 0.8% yield' or call with sport='all' to sweep every tracked league.

tools.name: pry_plus_ev
tools.description: Find positive expected-value (+EV) betting opportunities by comparing market odds against a sharp book's line or consensus price. Use to identify bets where the market price is better than the fair probability implies, e.g. 'what are the best +EV bets right now?' or call with sharp_book='pinnacle' and min_ev_pct=2.0 to only see edges above 2%.

tools.name: pry_props
tools.description: Get player prop betting lines (points, rebounds, assists, yards, strikeouts, ...) for a player or sport, with the market and book prices. Use to research player props before betting or building a props dashboard, e.g. 'what are LeBron James points props tonight?' or call with sport='nfl' and market='passing_yards' to see QB yardage props.

tools.name: pry_injuries
tools.description: Get the current injury report for a sport or team: player, team, injury detail, and status (out/questionable/active). Use to adjust betting models or fantasy lineups before lock, e.g. 'who is out for the Celtics tonight?' or call with sport='nfl' for the full league injury report.

tools.name: pry_live_odds
tools.description: Get live in-play odds that update during games (moneyline, spreads, totals as they move). Use for live-betting research or game-flow monitoring, e.g. 'what are the live odds for the Lakers game right now?' or call with sport='nba' and limit=50 for the current in-play slate.

tools.name: pry_scores
tools.description: Get final or live scores for one or more sports on a given day from ESPN public scoreboards (free, no quota, high-frequency safe). Use to check results or power a scores widget, e.g. 'what were the NBA scores on 20260815?' or call with sport='mlb' and date='today' for today's baseball scores.

tools.name: pry_historical_odds
tools.description: Get historical betting odds for past events from The Odds API history feed: the closing lines, opening lines, and best available prices for moneyline, spreads, and totals on a given date. Use to backtest betting models or audit how lines moved, e.g. 'what were the closing NFL moneylines on 20260810?' or call with sport='nba' and date='2026-08-01' for that day's historical slate.

tools.name: pry_betting_percentages
tools.description: Get public betting percentages (the share of bets and the share of money on each side of a game) across bookmakers, e.g. 'how much of the money is on the Chiefs tonight?' or call with sport='nfl' to see the whole slate. Use to spot sharp-side steam and contrarian plays where the public leans one way but the line is not moving.

tools.name: pry_alerts
tools.description: Get or manage money-printer alerts: significant line moves, sharp steam, limit-up CLV, and bettor-facing notifications you subscribe to. Use to stay on top of the market without polling, e.g. 'what alerts are active right now?' or call with alert_type='line_move' to list the biggest recent line moves across all sports.

tools.name: pry_books
tools.description: Aggregate live odds for one sport/market across all 112 sportsbooks in Pry's registry (US, offshore, EU, UK, and Asian books) by scraping each book directly through Pry's intelligent fallback chain — no paid odds API, no API keys. Use to find the best price anywhere for a slate, e.g. call with sport='nba' and market='h2h' to see every reachable book's moneyline for tonight's games, or pass market='spreads' to sweep the point-spread market across the whole registry.

tools.name: pry_book_coverage
tools.description: Get sportsbook coverage-registry statistics: how many of the 112 sportsbooks Pry scrapes directly, broken down by category (US, offshore, EU, UK, Asian), extraction method, and geo-requirement. Use to verify the breadth of the no-paid-API odds network before relying on it, e.g. 'how many US books do you cover?' or to confirm the 112-book total and the per-category split in one call.

tools.name: pry_prediction_markets
tools.description: Get live prediction-market data merged from Polymarket (Gamma API) and Kalshi (public trade API v2) — no API keys required. Each record includes the market question, binary outcomes with 0-1 probability prices (yes/no), 24h volume, liquidity, resolution/close date, and category. Use to gauge crowd consensus on future events, compare implied probabilities across platforms for arbitrage, or power event-probability widgets, e.g. 'what are the top crypto prediction markets right now?' or call with category='politics' to see election markets. Results are sorted by volume; both sources degrade independently, so a partial outage still returns the reachable side.

tools.name: pry_prediction_market_detail
tools.description: Look up a single prediction market by id or ticker and return its full detail: question, outcome prices (0-1 probabilities), volume, liquidity, resolution date, and source URL. Accepts a Polymarket market id or slug (e.g. 'will-bitcoin-hit-100k') or a Kalshi market ticker (e.g. 'KXNBAMVP-26'). Use to drill into one market after a pry_prediction_markets listing, or to check the current crowd probability for a specific event, e.g. 'what is the market pricing for the Fed rate decision?'

tools.name: pry_futures
tools.description: Get futures and championship odds across sportsbooks — Super Bowl winner, NBA MVP, league champions, award winners. Includes implied probability, best odds aggregation, and vig detection across all books. Use for long-term market research, e.g. 'who is favored to win the Super Bowl and at what price across books?' or call with sport='nba' to see every NBA futures market.

tools.name: pry_derivatives
tools.description: Price exotic bet derivatives — teasers, pleasers, if-bets, reverse bets, and round robins. Calculate adjusted lines, combined odds, payout scenarios, max win/loss, and breakeven points. Use to compare exotic bet structures before placing, e.g. 'price a 6-point teaser on these two spreads' or 'what does a 3-team round robin risk and pay?'. Pure math on the legs you supply — no live odds are fetched.

tools.name: pry_kelly_criterion
tools.description: Kelly criterion bankroll management — optimal bet sizing from win probability and odds. Includes full/half/quarter Kelly, CLV tracking, bankroll projections, and risk-of-ruin estimation. Use to size a bet, e.g. 'how much should I stake on a 55% win probability at 2.10 odds with a $1000 bankroll?' or call with kelly_pct=0.25 for a very conservative quarter-Kelly stake.

tools.name: pry_lineups
tools.description: Get the active/projected lineup, injury report, and minutes projection for a team's next game, from ESPN. Returns starters, bench, probable pitchers (MLB), questionable/doubtful players (game-time decisions), ruled-out players, and a per-player projected-minutes map (season MPG, haircut for players returning from injury, zero for ruled-out). Use before betting any player prop to confirm the player is actually starting and see his projected role, e.g. 'is LeBron James starting tonight and how many minutes is he projected?' or call with team='Celtics' to check the full rotation and injury list before the tip.

tools.name: pry_player_props_live
tools.description: Get ALL live player prop lines for one player across every bookmaker (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, ...) with a cross-book line-movement signal. Each record includes the prop type (points, rebounds, assists, yards, ...), the line, over/under odds, the book, and movement ('up'/'down'/'steady' versus the consensus median line across books). Falls back to ESPN season-average projected lines when no Odds API key is configured (labelled 'ESPN Estimate', no odds). Use to shop a player's props across books and spot lines that have moved, e.g. 'show me every Jayson Tatum prop right now and which books moved his points line up' or call with sport='nfl' for a QB's passing props.

tools.name: pry_player_stats
tools.description: Get a player's last N games of stats with per-game lines, averages, and a hot/cold trend flag per stat versus his season average, from the ESPN game log. Use to check recent form before betting a prop, e.g. 'how has Nikola Jokic been scoring over his last 10 games — hot or cold?' or call with games=5 for a short-form window. The trend map flags each stat 'hot' (recent avg >= 8% above season), 'cold' (>= 8% below), or 'steady'.

tools.name: pry_props_matchup
tools.description: Get ALL player props for both teams in a matchup, annotated with defensive context: how the opposing defense ranks against each core prop type (points, rebounds, assists, yards, ...) with a 'tough' (top-8 defense), 'average', or 'soft' (bottom-8) grade. Use to find props the matchup favors, e.g. 'show me every prop for Celtics @ Lakers and which defense is soft against threes' — the single call that replaces checking the slate, the injury report, and five books separately.

tools.name: pry_steam_moves
tools.description: Detect steam moves: lines that shifted across 3+ sportsbooks simultaneously inside a short lookback window — the loudest sharp money signal, since independent books rarely move in lockstep without a syndicate behind it. Each record includes the event, outcome, old/new line, books that moved, move direction and magnitude, and a confidence score (high when 5+ books moved together). Use to follow professional money in real time, e.g. 'any steam on tonight's NBA slate?' or call with lookback_minutes=30 right before tip-off to catch late sharp hits.

tools.name: pry_reverse_line_movement
tools.description: Find reverse line movement (RLM): lines that moved TOWARD the side with LESS public betting percentage — the classic sign that sharp money is fading the public. Each record includes the event, side, public bet %, line movement direction, whether the RLM signal fired, and a strength rating based on % divergence and move size. Requires a configured public betting-percentage feed (PRY_SHARP_BET_FEED); without it no signal is fabricated. Use to bet against the public when the line agrees with sharps, e.g. 'show RLM signals on the NFL slate' or call with sport='nba' before lineups lock.

tools.name: pry_bet_money_divergence
tools.description: Find bet-percentage vs money-percentage divergence: when a large share of TICKETS is on one team but the MONEY (dollars) is on the other, big bettors are on the minority side. Each record includes the event, side, bet %, money %, divergence (money minus bets), the identified sharp side, and a confidence rating. Requires a configured public betting-percentage feed (PRY_SHARP_BET_FEED). Use to spot where the wiseguy money disagrees with the public, e.g. 'where are sharps on the opposite side of the public in the NFL?' or call with sport='nba' for the full slate.

tools.name: pry_line_watch
tools.description: Lines worth watching for value: current vs opening line per event, which book currently holds the best number, total movement since the first recorded snapshot, and a value indicator (good_line / fair_line / bad_line) comparing the best price against the market consensus. Use to shop for the best available number before betting, e.g. 'which book has the best NBA moneyline prices right now?' or call with sport='nfl' to build a line-shopping dashboard.

tools.name: pry_sharp_report
tools.description: Full sharp money intelligence report for a sport: aggregates steam moves, reverse line movement signals, top bet/money divergences, line-watch items, and an overall sharp-indicators ranking of which games professional money is on. Use as a one-call daily briefing before betting, e.g. 'give me the sharp money report for tonight's NBA games' or call with sport='nfl' on Sunday morning for the week's sharpest angles.

tools.name: pry_sharp_consensus
tools.description: Games where MULTIPLE sharp indicators align on the same side: steam moves, reverse line movement, and bet/money divergence all pointing at one team. Each record includes the event, which indicators fired, the consensus sharp pick, a confidence level (high when 3+ indicators agree), and a recommended bet summary. Use for the highest-conviction plays only, e.g. 'which games have the strongest sharp consensus tonight?' or call with sport='nba' to filter the slate down to multi-signal games.

tools.name: pry_live_games
tools.description: Every in-progress game on a sport's slate right now, from ESPN's free public scoreboard: event_id, home/away, live scores, quarter, time remaining, status. Entry point for the other live tools — grab an event_id here. Example: 'what NBA games are live?'

tools.name: pry_live_game_state
tools.description: Full live state for one game: score, quarter, clock, possession, momentum (last five possessions when available), pace, scoring rate, remaining timeouts. Example: 'who has the ball and how fast is this game scoring?'

tools.name: pry_live_win_probability
tools.description: Live win probability for one game: home/away chances (ESPN's model when published, else a lead-vs-time heuristic), projected final scores, projected total, over/under probability vs the posted total, spread-cover probabilities. Example: 'who wins this game?'

tools.name: pry_live_scoring
tools.description: Scoring breakdown for one live game: per-quarter scores for both teams, lead changes, ties and quarter-by-quarter scoring runs. Example: 'how many lead changes tonight?'

tools.name: pry_live_betting_impact
tools.description: Live betting impact for one game: current margin vs the posted spread, pace-based total projection vs the posted total, and live value/arb opportunities (spread edge >= 3 pts, total edge >= 8 pts). Example: 'any live value on this game?'

tools.name: pry_game_weather
tools.description: Get current weather at a game venue (temperature, wind, precipitation, humidity, visibility) via Open-Meteo. Use before lock to check outdoor-game conditions, e.g. 'how windy is it in Chicago right now?'

tools.name: pry_weather_impact
tools.description: Translate venue weather into betting impact: wind/temp/precip bands, a total (points) adjustment, and pass-vs-run game lean. Use for NFL/NCAA outdoor totals and spread edges, e.g. 'does the wind favor the under tonight?'

tools.name: pry_game_context
tools.description: Full game-context bundle for a matchup: venue weather, weather impact on scoring, rest days / back-to-back flags (ESPN), and travel distance / time-zone / altitude change. Use for situational edges, e.g. 'any rest or travel edge for the Nuggets at the Lakers?'

tools.name: pry_scrape_methods
tools.description: List the extraction methods Pry uses to scrape sportsbook odds pages directly: JSON endpoints, __NEXT_DATA__ (Next.js), __NUXT__, __INITIAL_STATE__ / _dida_config_, HTML tables, and browser rendering. Use to understand how each book in the 112-book registry is reached and which fallback tiers apply, e.g. 'which books need a browser?' or to audit the no-paid-API scraping layer before building on it.

tools.name: pry_all_sources
tools.description: Aggregate one event's odds from every reachable source at once: The Odds API (free tier), ESPN, OddsPortal, Bovada, BetOnline, and the 112-book sportsbook registry scraped directly via intelligent fallback — more sources than any other odds service, with no paid odds API. Use to get the complete multi-source picture for a single event, e.g. call with event_id='nba:bda33adc...' and sources='all' to compare every book and feed on one matchup; the merged result is deduped with the sharpest line winning conflicts.

tools.name: pry_weather
tools.description: Get current weather and short-range forecasts for a location, built for research pipelines that need environmental context (rain, wind, temperature, AQI) alongside other data. Use to enrich scraping jobs or model outdoor conditions, e.g. 'what is the weather in Austin, TX right now?' or call with latitude/longitude to avoid geocoding.

tools.name: pry_agri
tools.description: Get agricultural data: crop conditions, growing-degree days, soil moisture, and commodity-relevant climate indices for a region. Use to model crop yield risk or monitor growing regions, e.g. 'what are the corn growing conditions in Iowa?' or call with region='us' and crop='corn' for the USDA-style condition report.

tools.name: pry_papers
tools.description: Search academic papers and preprints (arXiv, Semantic Scholar, PubMed) by keyword, author, or topic and return titles, abstracts, and citation counts. Use for research pipelines that need scholarly grounding, e.g. 'find recent papers on retrieval-augmented generation' or call with author='Smith' and limit=10 for recent works.

tools.name: pry_domain
tools.description: Get a domain intelligence report: WHOIS registration, SSL/TLS details, hosting provider, and technology fingerprint for a website. Use to enrich leads, vet domains before scraping, or map a competitor's stack, e.g. 'what can you tell me about example.com?' or call with domain='rugmunch.io' for hosting and tech details.

tools.name: pry_events
tools.description: Search live event listings (concerts, sports, theater) by keyword and optionally location or date, backed by Ticketmaster / SeatGeek class feeds. Use to find upcoming events for an artist or venue, e.g. 'what concerts are near Austin next month?' or call with query='Taylor Swift' and location='New York' for dated listings.

tools.name: pry_resale
tools.description: Get resale ticket pricing for a specific event: asking prices, ticket counts, and section-level ranges across resale marketplaces. Use with an event_id from pry_events to size demand before buying, e.g. call with event_id from a sold-out concert to see floor and nosebleed asking ranges side by side.

tools.name: pry_freight
tools.description: Get ocean container freight rates for a route: spot and contract rates per 40ft container across major trade lanes, plus FMC contract visibility where available. Use to model shipping costs, e.g. 'container rates from Shanghai to Los Angeles this week', or call with route='Far East to US West Coast' for the lane spread.

tools.name: pry_energy_lmp
tools.description: Get electricity locational marginal prices (LMP) for an ISO region and date, with day-ahead / real-time splits where available. Use to model energy costs or spot volatility, e.g. 'LMP for ERCOT today', or call with region='PJM' and date='2026-08-16' for nodal pricing snapshots.

tools.name: pry_grocery
tools.description: Get grocery prices for a product or category, optionally filtered by ZIP code for local store pricing. Use to compare staple costs across markets, e.g. 'price of a dozen eggs in 10001', or call with query='milk' and zip='78701' to see regional averages and store-level ranges.

tools.name: pry_restaurant
tools.description: Get a restaurant's menu with prices: items, sections, and per-dish pricing for a named restaurant. Use to build cost-of-dining datasets or research competitors, e.g. call with name="Katz's Delicatessen" and location='New York' for the full menu with prices.

tools.name: pry_imports
tools.description: Get U.S. customs import records for a company: shipment dates, commodity descriptions, suppliers, and origin countries. Use to size a competitor's supply chain or vet suppliers, e.g. call with company='Tesla Inc' for recent bill-of-lading entries with quantities.

tools.name: pry_firmographics
tools.description: Get firmographic data for a company: employee count band, revenue range, founding year, headquarters, industry, and company type. Use to segment leads or enrich CRM records, e.g. call with company='Rug Munch Media' for the standard firmographic profile with confidence scores.

tools.name: pry_app_search
tools.description: Search the Apple App Store by keyword and return matching apps — name, bundle id, price, rating, category, and store URL. Use to find apps by feature, compare pricing across categories, or feed app-market research, e.g. search query='crypto wallet' to list every mobile wallet on the store. Backed by the free public iTunes Search API; never raises and returns an empty list when the feed is unreachable.

tools.name: pry_app_reviews
tools.description: Get recent user reviews for an app by its store identifier — the numeric App Store id or bundle id, e.g. 'com.coinbase.app' — returning rating, title, body, author, and review date for each. Use to gauge app sentiment, triage support complaints, or feed product-research pipelines, e.g. reviews for '284910350' (Coinbase). Reads the free public App Store customer reviews feed; never raises and returns an empty list when the feed is unreachable.

tools.name: pry_news
tools.description: Search news articles by keyword across public news feeds and aggregators, returning title, source, published date, and URL for each result. Use to monitor a brand, topic, or competitor in the press, e.g. query='crypto regulation' for the latest regulatory coverage. Best-effort over free public feeds; never raises and returns an empty list when a feed is unreachable or rate-limited.

tools.name: pry_sentiment
tools.description: Score the sentiment of recent news about a keyword — positive / neutral / negative with a confidence score — using lightweight text analysis over the same public news feeds as pry_news. Use to gauge market or brand mood, e.g. query='Bitcoin ETF' before a trade or campaign. Degrades to a neutral score when no articles are found; never raises on feed failures.

tools.name: pry_company_watch
tools.description: Return the regulatory watch record for a company — recent enforcement actions, fines, sanctions, and compliance filings — e.g. company='OpenAI' for its compliance exposure. Use for due diligence, vendor screening, or competitor risk monitoring before partnering or trading. Backed by free public regulatory feeds; degrades to an empty record when no data is found.

tools.name: pry_deals
tools.description: Search deals, discounts, and promotions by keyword across public deal feeds, returning merchant, product, price, discount percentage, and expiry for each result. Use to build deal trackers, power shopping comparisons, or feed coupon content, e.g. query='PS5' for current console offers. Best-effort over free public sources; never raises and returns an empty list on failure.

tools.name: pry_drop_alert
tools.description: Check for drop alerts / limited product restock or flash-sale signals for a product, returning availability windows, price drops, and the merchant for each signal, e.g. product='RTX 5090' to track GPU drops. Use to power restock-notification bots, supply monitoring, or scalper-resistant buying queues. Best-effort over public feeds; degrades to an empty list when no drop signal is found.

tools.name: pry_contracts
tools.description: Search government contract opportunities and awards by keyword across public procurement feeds, returning agency, solicitation number, award value, status, and deadline for each result. Use to monitor public-sector RFPs and awarded contracts, e.g. query='cybersecurity' for current federal bidding data. Best-effort over free public sources; never raises and returns an empty list on failure.

tools.name: pry_grants
tools.description: Search government grant opportunities by keyword across public grant feeds, returning agency, opportunity number, funding amount, eligibility, and deadline for each result. Use to find open funding programs for research, nonprofits, or businesses, e.g. query='small business innovation research'. Best-effort over free public sources; never raises and returns an empty list on failure.

tools.name: pry_actor_catalog
tools.description: List every Pry Apify Store actor (109) with description, category, pricing events and per-event USD price. Store parity surface: anything runnable on Apify is discoverable here. Filter by optional 'domain' substring (e.g. 'monitor', 'crypto', 'seo'). Supports offset/limit pagination over the full catalog.

tools.name: pry_actor_run
tools.description: Run any Pry Apify actor's pipeline locally over URLs - same PPEScraperRunner + processor code path as the deployed store actors. Use after pry_actor_catalog: pass the actor name plus target urls; results are the same dataset items the Apify run would produce. x402 pay-per-call: each processed URL bills the actor's first PPE pricing event (see pry_actor_catalog / pry_x402_pricing for per-event USD prices). Examples: actor='news-feed-monitor', actor='universal-scraper', actor='token-safety-scanner'.
